company.name: Yahoo_香港商雅虎資訊股份有限公司

description.text:
【關於我們】
Yahoo台灣電子商務是台灣B2C、B2B2C和C2C電子商務行業的領先品牌。我們的願景是關注用戶需求和體驗，致力為每個品牌、商店、賣家和買家提供能夠滿足不同需求的平台。
【Responsibilities】
・Responsible for the design and development of end-to-end features in current and future products within domain of expertise
・Plan, design, develop, code and test software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products; revise and refine as required
・Participate in development of project timelines, implementation design specifications, system flow diagrams, documentation, testing and ongoing support of systems
・Maintain existing products, assisting in the maintenance of domains outside of main area of expertise
・Continually learning new skills and being self-development
-----------------------
【Expected Qualification】
・Proficient in leveraging AI to enhance software development and process automation
・Have experience in Java server-side API development, be good at Spring Boot application development
・Good knowledge of Internet application development and architecture, ex: HTTP, Networking, Information Security, and Web industry standard
・Hands-on storage environment, e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, Redis etc.
・Experience on development on Linux based systems, command line and scripting
・Communicative proficiency in Mandarin and English
※ 請直接投遞履歷至Yahoo TWEC Career Site，會以此網站做履歷篩選※
【https://yahootwec.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/4/home/requisition/67?c=yahootwec】

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【Preferable Qualification】
・Good knowledge on cyber security, including authentication & authorization
・Experience on working with large scale distributed systems and container tech
・Hands-on operating applications on Kubernetes(k8s) environment, e.g. auto-scaling, storage plan, recovery, BCP plan
・With AWS, GCP or Azure related cloud experience
・Experience in troubleshooting and performance tuning in the server-side system
・Good knowledge to improve efficiency of DevOps (CI/CD), including unit & functional automation testing
・Great sense of responsibility and attention to detail
